BELIEVER-DIVINITY_TEST_CARD.title: Divinity Test
BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_CARD.title: Omniscience
BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_CARD.description:
Only playable at 7 Divinity.
Consume 7 Divinity: draw 3 cards, remove all debuffs, gain all unlocked Miracles and make cards cost 0. Take no HP loss until the enemy's turn ends.
BELIEVER-DEV_MIRACLE_TEST_CARD.title: Test Miracle
BELIEVER-LET_THERE_BE_LIGHT.title: Let There Be Light
BELIEVER-LET_THERE_BE_LIGHT.description:
Deal 30 damage to ALL enemies.
Apply 2 Vulnerable.
BELIEVER-GENESIS.title: Genesis
BELIEVER-GENESIS.description:
Extend Omniscience by 1 player turn.
Can only happen once per Omniscience.
BELIEVER-FOUR_HORSEMEN.title: Four Horsemen
BELIEVER-FOUR_HORSEMEN.description:
Conquest: Deal 15 damage to ALL enemies and apply 2 Vulnerable.
War: Deal 20 damage to ALL enemies.
Famine: Deal 15 damage to ALL enemies and apply 2 Weak.
Death: Deal 45 damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.
BELIEVER-PARTING_OF_THE_RED_SEA.title: Parting of the Red Sea
BELIEVER-PARTING_OF_THE_RED_SEA.descript:
Deal 30 damage to ALL enemies.
Gain 40 Block. Retain your Block next turn.
BELIEVER-TEN_PLAGUES.title: Ten Plagues
BELIEVER-TEN_PLAGUES.description: Deal 6 damage to a random enemy 10 times.
BELIEVER-FALL_OF_JERICHO.title: Fall of Jericho
BELIEVER-FALL_OF_JERICHO.description:
Remove Block from ALL enemies.
Deal 25 damage to ALL enemies.
Apply 2 Vulnerable.
BELIEVER-JUDGMENT_OF_FIRE.title: Judgment of Fire
BELIEVER-JUDGMENT_OF_FIRE.description:
Deal 70 damage to an enemy.
If this kills it, deal 25 damage to ALL other enemies.
BELIEVER-SEVEN_SEALS.title: Seven Seals of the Lamb
BELIEVER-SEVEN_SEALS.description:
Deal 7 damage to ALL enemies 7 times.
Then deal 15 damage to ALL enemies.
BELIEVER-FIVE_LOAVES_AND_TWO_FISH.title: Five Loaves and Two Fish
BELIEVER-FIVE_LOAVES_AND_TWO_FISH.descri:
Choose an ordinary card in your hand.
Add 3 temporary copies of it to your hand. They cost 0 and disappear at the end of your turn.
BELIEVER-LAZARUS_RISES.title: Lazarus Rises
BELIEVER-LAZARUS_RISES.description:
Choose up to 3 ordinary cards from your exhaust pile.
Put them into your hand. Their cost is 0 this turn.
BELIEVER-LAZARUS_RISES.selectionScreenPr: Choose up to 3 cards to return to your hand.
BELIEVER-LORD_OF_HOSTS.title: Lord of Hosts
BELIEVER-LORD_OF_HOSTS.description:
This turn, whenever you play an ordinary card, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
Triggers up to 8 times.
BELIEVER-WHITE_THRONE_JUDGMENT.title: White Throne Judgment
BELIEVER-WHITE_THRONE_JUDGMENT.descripti:
Deal 35 damage to ALL enemies.
Bosses take 40 more damage.
After damage, non-boss enemies below 30% HP are killed.
